finalText:
**Bigger than a rename, but mostly mechanical.** `account_id` shows up in 1082 places across 94 files.

Safe to rename: the actual service code — `services/orders`, `services/notify`, `services/billing`, `services/analytics`, `services/accounts` (repo/service/http layers, ~90 files).

Must not rename, three spots:

- `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` — third-party vendored code, not ours to edit
- [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:16) and [lib/serialize.js](lib/serialize.js:8) — `account_id` is the frozen public API field name, comments say renaming it breaks every client
- `migrations/*.sql` — applied migrations are history, editing the DB column name there breaks the down step without renaming anything in prod

Next: tell the platform team it's an internal-only rename. Public contract and vendor SDK stay `account_id`.
